title: Ordered affine-space trace right functor
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$, $N\in\mathbf N$, and $h_A:(N:A)=0$. For a scheme $S$ of universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme], work in ordinary unbounded etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $X_0(S)=S$, $X_{d+1}(S)=\mathbf A^1_{X_d(S)}$ be the ordered affine coordinate tower with its standard projective-line compactifications [def-amb-affine-trace-tower]. Let $G_{q_T}$ be the canonical ordinary projective-line right functor, namely inverse image followed by tensor on the right with the finite Tate line shifted by two [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], and let $j_T:\mathbf A^1_T\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_T$ be the standard affine chart. Define the affine-line right functor $H_T=G_{q_T}$ followed by exact inverse image $j_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Define $G_{0,S}=\mathrm{Id}$ and $G_{d+1,S}=G_{d,S}$ followed by $H_{X_d(S)}$. Thus $G_{d,S}:D(S_{et},A)\to D(X_d(S)_{et},A)$ is the ordered iterated shifted-line-twist functor. This definition chooses no adjunction, orientation or trace, and asserts no isomorphism theorem.
